## Overview

`dearseq` is a package for analyzing RNA-seq data. The 2 main functions
of the package are
[`dear_seq()`](https://borishejblum.github.io/dearseq/reference/dear_seq.md)
and
[`dgsa_seq()`](https://borishejblum.github.io/dearseq/reference/dgsa_seq.md):

- **Gene-wise Differential Analysis of RNA-seq data** can be performed
  using the function
  [`dear_seq()`](https://borishejblum.github.io/dearseq/reference/dear_seq.md).
- **Gene Set Analysis of RNA-seq data** can be performed using the
  function
  [`dgsa_seq()`](https://borishejblum.github.io/dearseq/reference/dgsa_seq.md).

The methods implemented in this package are detailed in the following
articles:

> Gauthier M, Agniel D, Thiébaut R & Hejblum BP (2020). dearseq: a
> variance component score test for RNA-Seq differential analysis that
> effectively controls the false discovery rate, *NAR Genomics and
> Bioinformatics* **2**(*4*):lqaa093 [DOI:
> 10.1093/nargab/lqaa093](https://doi.org/10.1093/nargab/lqaa093)
> [bioRxiv:635714](https://www.biorxiv.org/content/10.1101/635714v1)

♻️ Reproducible code files for the results presented in Gauthier *et
al.* (2020) can be dowloaded [here: 👉 🌐 *NAR G&B* reproducible code
files](https://github.com/borishejblum/dearseq/releases/download/v1.7.2/NARGAB_ReproducibleCodeFiles.zip)

> Agniel D & Hejblum BP (2017). Variance component score test for
> time-course gene set analysis of longitudinal RNA-seq data,
> [*Biostatistics*](https://academic.oup.com/biostatistics/article-abstract/18/4/589/3065599),
> **18**(*4*):589-604.
> [arXiv:1605.02351](https://arxiv.org/abs/1605.02351v4) [DOI:
> 10.1093/biostatistics/kxx005](https://doi.org/10.1093/biostatistics/kxx005)

More information about `dearseq` can be found [here: 👉 🌐 pkgdown
website](https://borishejblum.github.io/dearseq/)

## Installation

***`dearseq` is available from
[Bioconductor](https://www.bioconductor.org)***

``` r

#install.packages("BiocManager")
BiocManager::install("dearseq")
```

The development version of `dearseq` is available on
[GitHub](https://github.com/borishejblum/dearseq):

``` r

#install.packages("BiocManager")
remotes::install_github("borishejblum/dearseq")
```

– Marine Gauthier, Denis Agniel & Boris Hejblum

# Package index

## All functions

- [`PBT_gmt`](https://borishejblum.github.io/dearseq/reference/PBT_gmt.md)
  : PBT gene sets related to kidney transplant
- [`baduel_5gs`](https://borishejblum.github.io/dearseq/reference/baduel_5gs.md)
  : Small portion of RNA-seq data from plant physiology study.
- [`dear_seq()`](https://borishejblum.github.io/dearseq/reference/dear_seq.md)
  : Differential expression analyis of RNA-seq data through a variance
  component test
- [`dearseq`](https://borishejblum.github.io/dearseq/reference/dearseq-package.md)
  [`dearseq-package`](https://borishejblum.github.io/dearseq/reference/dearseq-package.md)
  : dearseq: Differential Expression Analysis for RNA-seq data through a
  robust variance component test
- [`dgsa_seq()`](https://borishejblum.github.io/dearseq/reference/dgsa_seq.md)
  : Time-course Gene Set Analysis
- [`permPvals()`](https://borishejblum.github.io/dearseq/reference/permPvals.md)
  : Exact permutation p-values
- [`plot(`*`<dearseq>`*`)`](https://borishejblum.github.io/dearseq/reference/plot.dearseq.md)
  : Plot method for dearseq objects
- [`plot_hist_pvals()`](https://borishejblum.github.io/dearseq/reference/plot_hist_pvals.md)
  : Plotting raw p-values histogram
- [`plot_ord_pvals()`](https://borishejblum.github.io/dearseq/reference/plot_ord_pvals.md)
  : Plot of gene-wise p-values
- [`plot_weights()`](https://borishejblum.github.io/dearseq/reference/plot_weights.md)
  : Plotting mean-variance fit for precision weights estimation
- [`sp_weights()`](https://borishejblum.github.io/dearseq/reference/sp_weights.md)
  : Non parametric local heteroscedasticity weights
- [`spaghettiPlot1GS()`](https://borishejblum.github.io/dearseq/reference/spaghettiPlot1GS.md)
  : Spaghetti plot for Specific Gene Set
- [`summary(`*`<dearseq>`*`)`](https://borishejblum.github.io/dearseq/reference/summary.dearseq.md)
  [`print(`*`<summary.dearseq>`*`)`](https://borishejblum.github.io/dearseq/reference/summary.dearseq.md)
  : Summary method for dearseq objects
- [`vc_test_asym()`](https://borishejblum.github.io/dearseq/reference/vc_test_asym.md)
  : Asymptotic variance component test statistic and p-value
- [`vc_test_perm()`](https://borishejblum.github.io/dearseq/reference/vc_test_perm.md)
  : Permutation-based variance component test statistic and p-value
- [`voom_weights()`](https://borishejblum.github.io/dearseq/reference/voom_weights.md)
  : Precision weights accounting for heteroscedasticity in RNA-seq count
  data
